name: Yun Song Il

attribution.legal_posture: Republic of Korea autonomous sanctions designation. The UN Panel reports Member State allegations; the legal posture is administrative, with no UN Committee designation or criminal charge or conviction on record.

caveats: The claims were Member State information, and the Lao People’s Democratic Republic had not replied at publication.
The individuals and company were designated by two Member States; the report attributes the designations to Member State action rather than the UN Committee.

statements: A Member State reported Tongmyong Technology Trade Company as a Laos-based Munitions Industry Department affiliate that dispatched IT workers; its reported representative was Kim Hyo Dong, while Yu Song Hyok and Yun Song Il reportedly arranged office space/accommodation and mediated with foreign brokers to cash out embezzled virtual assets.

identity_boundary: Yun Song Il (윤성일) is preserved as the Laos-context person named in a UN Panel report and the Republic of Korea's 23 May 2023 autonomous-sanctions release. Preserve the ROK's two-person financial-helper allegation separately from the five IT branch heads. A second Latin-only Yun Song Il in a 2024 UN Russia-case table remains separate because no Korean-name, birth, Laos, restaurant, designation or unique-selector bridge exists.
